replicated_originals.reference: Wichert, Wolf & Schwabe (2013a) Changing memories after reactivation: A one-time opportunity? (Experiment 1)

A.reason: The paper states 'we attempted to replicate Wichert et al.'s (experiment 1, 2013a) findings', and its reference list gives 2013a as 'Changing memories after reactivation: A one-time opportunity?' (Neurobiology of Learning and Memory, 99, 38-49).

B.reason: Wichert et al. (2013b) supplied the larger 60-picture stimulus set and the small procedural changes (2 s viewing time, ratings at the end). It is cited as the source of materials and methods, not as the finding being replicated.

notes: The paper is a failed replication of Experiment 1 of Wichert et al. 2013a. It reproduces some of the original contrasts (Re+NL vs Re and vs no Re+no NL), but not the key Re+NL vs NL difference. Candidate A gives the first author's first name as 'Sven'. The source only gives the initial 'S.', and the 2013b candidate (B) has 'Sonja'. This is a likely minor first-name error; the title, year and DOI agree.
